media.title: An automated App Store screenshot workflow translating polished assets into additional languages

title: Automate Polished, Localized App Store Screenshots
summary: Antoine van der Lee demonstrates an automated App Store screenshot pipeline that combines RocketSim's CLI, Helm's CLI, and Sketch's MCP to improve screenshots and translate them into more languages while keeping token use efficient. An iOS team can split capture, design, and localization into tool-specific stages instead of asking one agent to infer the entire workflow.
takeaway: Give capture, design, and localization to purpose-built tools, then make the agent coordinate their outputs and verify each locale rather than regenerating every screenshot from scratch.
